title.zh: 将民都洛省1903年度土地税缴纳期限延至1904年6月30日，并规定退还已缴罚款的法案
title.en: AN ACT EXTENDING THE TIME FOR THE PAYMENT OF THE LAND TAX IN THE PROVINCE OF MINDORO FOR THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND THREE UNTIL JUNE THIRTIETH, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FOUR, AND PROVIDING FOR THE REFUND OF PENALTIES ALREADY PAID.
title.orig: AN ACT EXTENDING THE TIME FOR THE PAYMENT OF THE LAND TAX IN THE PROVINCE OF MINDORO FOR THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND THREE UNTIL JUNE THIRTIETH, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FOUR, AND PROVIDING FOR THE REFUND OF PENALTIES ALREADY PAID.
title.vi: Đạo luật gia hạn thời hạn nộp thuế đất năm 1903 tại Tỉnh Mindoro đến ngày 30 tháng 6 năm 1904 và quy định hoàn lại tiền phạt đã nộp
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติขยายเวลาการชำระภาษีที่ดินสำหรับปี พ.ศ. 2446 ในจังหวัดมินโดโรจนถึงวันที่ 30 มิถุนายน พ.ศ. 2447 และกำหนดให้คืนเงินค่าปรับที่ได้ชำระแล้ว
title.id: Undang-Undang yang memperpanjang waktu pembayaran pajak tanah tahun 1903 di Provinsi Mindoro hingga 30 Juni 1904 dan mengatur pengembalian denda yang telah dibayar

text.en:
The period for the payment, without penalty, of the land tax for the year nineteen hundred and
three in the Province of Mindoro is hereby extended to June thirtieth, nineteen hundred and four, anything in
previous Acts to the contrary notwithstanding. All penalties heretofore collected for the nonpayment of the
land tax in such province for the year nineteen hundred and three are hereby remitted, and the provincial
supervisor-treasurer of the province mentioned above is authorized and directed to allow a rebate of the
amount of such penalty to the taxpayer upon whom the penalty was assessed upon payment of his land tax
for the year next ensuing.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth. nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 26, 1904.
